namingTool.adaptation: Resolve named member/local class binary prefixes from javac declaration simple names, preserving local ordinals and dollar characters. Compose containing-class renames recursively, including untouched top-level dollar names. Constructors, owner/type descriptors, literal loading, lexical labels and all bindings are recompiled and verified; output collisions fail before publication.
